public_rationale: This is a stated belief that OpenAI 'in its current form is untenable'. He gave no test, no threshold and no time frame, and 'current form' could mean its structure, its financing or its business model. In the same post he says he is not claiming OpenAI will surely collapse. Grading it would mean the evaluator inventing both the meaning of 'current form' and the test for 'untenable', which would be unfair to the speaker. So it is not graded.
limitations: Context evidence on cash burn does not bear on a claim with no measure.

statement.excerpt: I ultimately believe that OpenAI in its current form is untenable.

our_interpretation: This is a stated belief about whether OpenAI can last. 'Untenable' has no measure, and 'current form' could mean its legal structure, its financing, or its business model.
The same post says 'What I am not saying is that OpenAI will for sure collapse', so the speaker did not commit to a collapse or a date.
Any test would require the evaluator to choose what 'current form' means and what counts as 'untenable'. That would put words in his mouth, so the claim is not graded.
criteria.support_condition: Not adjudicable: no measure or period stated. A finding would need a reading the speaker did not give.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Not adjudicable for the same reason.
